submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a threshold of 42 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.013% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. Through systematic simulation scans across the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV), I identified that Algorithm-L1 consistently outperforms Algorithm-L2 and Algorithm-L3 across all tested thresholds. The optimal threshold of 42 GeV was determined by testing multiple threshold values and finding the peak efficiency. This configuration meets all hardware constraints: it fits within the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), is compatible with the 25 Gb/s optical link bandwidth, and operates within the specified threshold range. The iterative topological clustering with learned calibration (Algorithm-L1) provides superior performance compared to sliding-window clustering (Algorithm-L2, ~84-86% efficiency) and fixed-window sum (Algorithm-L3, ~74% efficiency).
